events.event: President Prabowo formally submitted Sugiono and Andi Amran Sulaiman to the MPR as the two candidates to replace Gibran Rakabuming Raka as Vice President.
events.key_numbers: 2 candidates · submitted 23 Nov 2026 · MPR verification team formed 13 Nov, reportedly 36 people · verification up to 7 days (Pasal 127) · gaps fixable until 4 days before plenary (Pasal 128) · term runs to 2029
events.why_it_matters: Dasco, the name widely tipped, was not chosen; the surprise pick sets who becomes Indonesia's next Vice President.
events.spreading_evidence: Four CNN Indonesia items on the nasional front page on 23 Nov (13:43-18:18)

events.event: CNN Indonesia reports the MPR plenary to vote for the new Vice President is set for 11 December, after earlier dates of 2 and 9 December.
events.key_numbers: Plenary 11 Dec 2026 (earlier 2 Dec, then 9 Dec) · tie rule: vote repeated once, then president picks one of the two · winner confirmed by Ketetapan MPR
events.why_it_matters: The date for the vote has moved again, so viewers need the current schedule and how the vote works.

events.event: Lawyers for ex-Deputy Minister Silmy Karim said at the Jakarta Tipikor trial that he built a system to prevent illegal levies and that the extortion allegation must be proven.
events.why_it_matters: A former immigration chief's defence in an extortion case shows how the trial is shaping up.

events.event: Police questioned two people identified as EK and LS for 12 hours in the alleged rape case against Kupang Regent Yosef Lede.
events.why_it_matters: A sitting regional head faces a serious allegation and the investigation is still widening.
